home.tagline: Every PDF chore, done on your own machine.
home.subtitle: No upload, no account, no connection. Your documents never leave this computer.
home.trayHint: Pick a tool — it will start with these files.

images-to-pdf.name: Images → PDF
images-to-pdf.desc: Turn JPG, PNG or WebP files into one document.

merge.name: Merge
merge.desc: Join several PDFs end to end.

split.name: Split
split.desc: Cut a PDF into several files.

pdf-to-images.name: PDF → Images
pdf-to-images.desc: Export every page as PNG, JPG or WebP.

extract-text.name: Extract text
extract-text.desc: Pull the text out into a .txt file.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.desc: Read and edit title, author, keywords.

dropzone.idlePdf: Drop a PDF here, or click to browse
dropzone.idlePdfs: Drop your PDFs here, or click to browse
dropzone.idleImages: Drop your images here, or click to browse
dropzone.idleAny: Drop PDFs or images here, or click to browse

files.pickHint: click a document to work on it
files.ignoredImages_one: {{count}} image set aside: this tool only takes PDFs.
files.ignoredImages_other: {{count}} images set aside: this tool only takes PDFs.
files.ignoredPdfs_one: {{count}} PDF set aside: this tool only takes images.
files.ignoredPdfs_other: {{count}} PDFs set aside: this tool only takes images.

settings.saveAskHint: A dialog opens on every save.
